name: Candles of Beckoning
summary: Candles of Beckoning is a brief task centered around salvaging specialized ritual tapers discovered in Tirisfal Glades. These eerie tallow candles are steeped in dark practices and recovered directly from crates left among the shadows of Lordaeron's ruins.

sections.title: Tallow and Dark Rites
sections.body: The crate on Gunther's Retreat supplies the Candle of Beckoning used in his test of allegiance. Gunther asks an adventurer to take a candle to the old, bloody altar just off the island's southern coast, light it, and confront the Scourge agent Lillith Nefara.

sections.title: A Reclaimed Relic
sections.body: The crate holding these candles sits on Gunther's Retreat, the island in Brightwater Lake where the lich Gunther Arcanus dwells. A single candle is all that is needed for the test Gunther sets in Proving Allegiance: lit upon the old, bloody altar off the island's southern coast, it awakens the Scourge agent Lillith Nefara.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Candles of Beckoning?
faq.answer: A Candle of Beckoning is lit on the bloody altar near Gunther's Retreat to awaken Lillith Nefara for Gunther's test of allegiance.

aliases: where to find candles of beckoning
faq.answer: They are stored in a Crate of Candles on Gunther's Retreat, Gunther Arcanus's island in Brightwater Lake in Tirisfal Glades.
The source does not name their maker. Gunther keeps a crate of candles on his island for the test he sets in Proving Allegiance.

faq.q: Why does the Horde or Forsaken want them?
faq.answer: A candle is needed for Gunther Arcanus's test in Proving Allegiance. Lit on the bloody altar off his island's southern coast, it awakens the Scourge agent Lillith Nefara, and destroying her proves you are the Lich King's foe.

faq.q: Can just anyone use the candle?
faq.answer: The Candle of Beckoning is placed on Lillith's bloody dinner table and lit to summon her for Gunther's test.

faq.q: Are the candles linked to the Scourge?
faq.answer: The candle awakens Lillith Nefara, a powerful Scourge agent. Gunther asks you to destroy her to prove you are the Lich King's enemy.

angles.text: For the Forsaken, salvaging occult implements in Tirisfal is a matter of both survival and study, ensuring dangerous artifacts do not fall into hostile hands.
Practitioners of the dark arts readily recognize the distinct tallow and magical resonance used in ritual beckoning.
Shadow priests understand the delicate balance required when handling items crafted to invoke lingering spirits and call forth unseen presences.
